sammendrag: Philippus, kardinalpräst i San Lorenzo in Lucina Henricus Bella, a Dominican friar and priest from the diocese of Turku, once assaulted a layman who was supposed to maintain the organ bellows but did not do his job well. Henricus hit him on the back five times with a stick. Three days later the layman was struck down with a pestilent abscess in his left armpit. Since the plague was raging there at the time and the examination of the layman had shown no bruises from the blows he had received, it was considered that he died becasuse of the inflamed abscess and not from the blows. Henricus nevertheless abstained from celebrating after these events. Philippus, cardinal priest of San Lorenzo in Lucina, refers the case to the auditor Anthonius de Grassis for inspection and commissions the diocesan bishop to declare Henricus innocent of homicide and not irregular, on condition that the facts above are true.
DF_source: Arkistolähteet: Vatikaani, Archivum Secretum Vaticanum, Archivio della Penitenzieria Apostolica, Reg. Matrim. et Divers.; Lähde-editiot: APS, #116.Auctoritate Papae. The Church Province of Uppsala and the Apostolic Penitentiary 1410–1526. Sara Risberg (edition), Kirsi Salonen (introduction). Stockholm: National Archives of Sweden 2008.
brevtekst:
Philippus (kardinalpräst) i San Lorenzo in Lucina hänvisar en supplik till auditor Anthonius de Grassis för kontroll och ger biskopen i Åbo i uppdrag att förklara Henrik Bella, dominikanpräst i Åbo stift, oskyldig till anklagelsen för mord och inte irregulär, under förutsättning att de uppgifter som lämnats är riktiga: Henrik angrep en gång den lekman som skulle se över orgelbälgen för att han gjort ett dåligt jobb och slog honom på ryggen med en käpp fem gånger. Tre dagar senare drabbades lekmannen av en pestsmittad böld i vänster armhåla. Pesten härjade just då i området, och när han undersöktes uppvisade lekmannen inga blåmärken efter slagen. Sålunda konstaterades att det var den inflammerade bölden som tog hans liv och inte Henriks slag. Henrik har dock avstått från att fira gudstjänst efter dessa händelser.
Frater Henricus Bella presbyter Aboensis diocesis professus ordinis fratrum predicatorum exponit, quod, cum alias quidam laicus pro ducendis follibus pro flatu organorum ministrando extitisset tunc depputatus, qui quidem laicus in excercitio illo minus debite servivit, propter quod dictus orator ira provocatus prefatum laicum cum quodam parvo baculo in dorso supra tunicam quinque ictibus percussit. Tertio vero die sub assella sinistra dictus laicus apostemate pestilentiali fuit percussus. Cum pestis ibidem vigerit et super verberibus baculi huiusmodi nichil lesionis rubei sive lividi per examinem deputatum extitit eventum sed ex inflatione dicti apostematis ingressus est viam carnis universe. De cuius morte exponens prefatus plurimum doluit, prout dolet de presenti. Qui tandem a celebratione divinorum postmodum reverenter abstinuit, quoniam bonarum mentium est ibi culpam timere, ubi culpa minime reperitur. Quandoque et a nonnullis simplicibus et iuris<ignaris> asseritur ipsum propter premissis homicidii reatum incurrisse ac inhabilitatis et irregularitatis notam contraxisse, ad obstruenda igitur ora talium et aliorum sibi super hoc obloqui volentium emulorum supplicat exponens sanctitati vestre, quatenus ipsum premissorum occasione nullum homicidii reatum incurrisse nullamque irregularitatis sive inhabilitatis notam contraxisse misericorditer declarari mandare dignemini ut in forma. Fiat ut infra. Philippus sancti Laurentii in Lucina. Videat eam dominus Anthonius de Grassis. Philippus. Comittatur ordinario, quod, si vocatis vocandis sibi constiterit, quod laicus prefatus non ex percussionibus predictis sed ex alia, ut prefertur, infirmitate, que a dictis percussionibus prorsus radicem non habuit, mortuus sit et de aliis expositis, declaret, ut petitur.

sammendrag: Johannes, penitentiarians regens, abbot av San Bernardo (in Valldigna) The priest Johannes Johannis in Kokemäki (Kumo), in the diocese of Turku, explains that once in the pulpit he forbade certain troublemakers and debtors from entering the church. A parishioner, Lars of Kokemäki, angrily asked Johannes why he had done this. Johannes patiently listened to his harsh words without responding, and left. After supper that day, when Johannes – carrying no weapons, since he did not suspect anything – was on his way to a certain house, Lars followed him. On the way back Lars suddenly came up to him, and Johannes calmly told him to not stand in his way. But Lars would not calm down. Instead, he called Johannes the devil’s priest and tried to attack him with a wooden object. Johannes took hold of an axe and hit Lars lightly in the arm with its reverse side, not to kill him but only to repel his fury. In fury, Lars rushed at Johannes and hurt himself in the head on the axe. He died the next day from this wound. Johannes requests to be absolved from any charge of homicide and to be dispensed, so that he may minister and receive an ecclesiastical office without the cure of souls. The regent Johannes, abbot of San Bernardo (in Valldigna) grants the petition.
DF_source: Arkistolähteet: Vatikaani, Archivum Secretum Vaticanum, Archivio della Penitenzieria Apostolica, Reg. Matrim. et Divers.; Lähde-editiot: APS, #145.Auctoritate Papae. The Church Province of Uppsala and the Apostolic Penitentiary 1410–1526. Sara Risberg (edition), Kirsi Salonen (introduction). Stockholm: National Archives of Sweden 2008.
oversettelse:
(Penitentiarians) regens Johannes, abbot i San Bernardo (i Valldigna) beviljar prästen Johan Johansson i Kokemäki/Kumo i Åbo stift dispens att fortsätta tjänstgöra och erhålla en kyrklig tjänst utan själavård och absolution för mord. När Johan en gång från predikstolen hade förbjudit vissa bråkmakare och gäldenärer att komma in i kyrkan, blev en av sockenborna, Lars, mycket upprörd över detta. Samma kväll blev Johan förföljd av Lars, och när han var på väg hem kom Lars fram till honom, kallade honom "djävulens präst" och försökte angripa honom med ett träföremål. Johan, som inte bar något vapen eftersom han inte hade anat detta, fick fatt på en yxa från en person som stod i närheten och slog Lars lätt på armen med dess baksida, inte för att döda eller skada honom utan endast för att få hans ilska att lägga sig. Lars kastade sig då på Johan och skadade sig i huvudet på yxan. Dagen därpå avled han.
Iohannes Iohannis presbyter rector parrochialis ecclesie loci Kume Aboensis diocesis exponit, quod alias quadam die dominica certis contumacibus et debitoribus ecclesie predicte canonica monitione premissa iuxta statuta et consuetudines illius patrie publice de ambone ingressum interdiceret. Et quidam Laurentius Kumena laicus dicte sue ecclesie parrochianus exinde iracundia provocatus quam plurima verba iniuriosa eidem oratori intulit petens, cur cuidam eius amico et vicino ingressum ecclesie interdixisset. Ipse vero huiusmodi verba iniuriosa patienter sustinens nichil respondens ab eodem laico discessit. Peracto siquidem prandio illius diei prefatus exponens usque ad certam domum, ad quam tunc erat iturus, nichil mali suspicans etiam sine armis se contulit. Et dictus laicus clam ipsum fuit insecutus. Tandem exponente inde redeunte dictus laicus subito ei obviam <se> dedit, cui satis modeste ipse exponens allocutus est dicens eidem, ne se de illo negotio impediret. Laicus vero pacificari renuens oratorem presbyterum diaboli vocans cum aliis verbis iniuriosis et cum quodam instrumento ligneo, quod in manu gestabat, in ipsum exponentem irruere conabatur. Quod videns exponens certam securim ex manu eiusdem a casu stantis arripuit non animo interficendi sive mutilandi sed tantum furiam dicti laici reppellendi leviter super brachio cum deteriori parte securis percuttere voluit. Laicus igitur furiosius in exponentem irruit, qui se ipsum in ista securi in capite vulneravit, de quo vulnere altera die expiravit. Petit igitur dictus exponens a reatu huiusmodi homicidii, si quod incurrit, et excessibus ac peccatis suis aliis absolvi ac secum, ne in cleri obprobrium mendicare cogatur, ut in minoribus ordinibus libere ministrare possit et beneficium ecclesiasticum sine cura obtinere, dispensari mandare dignemini. Fiat de speciali. Iohannes abbas sancti Bernardi Vallensis regens etc.

Johannes Johannis, Kokemäki (Kume) -nimisen paikan seurakunnan kirkkoherra Turun hiippakunnassa, kielsi eräänä sunnuntaina kahdelta tietyltä uppiniskaiselta mainitun kirkon velalliselta kanonisen kehoituksen jälkeen saman hiippakunnan asetusten ja tavan mukaisesti sisäänpääsyn kirkkoon. Ja kun Laurentius Kokemäkeläinen (Kumena), maallikko, sanotun hänen kirkkonsa seurakuntalainen sitten kävi saman anojan kimppuun esittäen monenlaisia loukkauksia ja kysyi miksi hänen ystävältään ja naapuriltaan oli kielletty sisäänpääsy kirkkoon, tämä itse loukkaavat sanat kärsivällisesti kestäen ei vastannut mitään ja erosi maallikosta. Nautittuaan sitten lounaansa edellämainittu anoja oli lähtenyt samana päivänä käynnille erääseen taloon ilman että epäili mitään pahaa ja niin, ettei hänellä ollut aseita mukanaan. Ja kun anojan sieltä palatessa sanottu maallikko, joka vaikutti ikään kuin verenhimoisesti seuranneen häntä, asettui äkkiä hänen tielleen ja ilmoitti olevansa tyytymätön anojan kanssa käytyyn keskusteluun ja ettei asia estäisi häntä tekemästä mitään ja kieltäytyen rauhoittumasta ja nimittäen anojaa perkeleen papiksi ja muilla loukkaavilla sanoilla ja yrittäen käydä anojan kinppuun erään kädessä pitämänsä puisen esineen avulla, anoja tämän nähdessään otti kirveen erään sattumalta paikalla olleen kädestä ja ilman että oli aikeissa surmata tai vahingoittaa sanottua maallikkoa vaan rauhoitella tämän suuttumusta, koetti lyödä tätä kirveen hamarapuolella varovasti käsivarteen, maallikko kävikin raivoissaan anojan kimppuun, niin että haavoittui kirveen iskusta päähän, johon haavaan hän seuraavana päivänä menehtyi. Niinpä pyytää sanottu anoja vapautusta syytöksestä tällä tavoin tapahtuneeseen tappoon, jos hänet katsotaan siihen syylliseksi ja samalla synninpäästöä kaikista muista rasitteistaan ja synneistään ja jotta ei joutuisi papistolle epäsoveliaalla tavalla kerjäämään, mahdollisuutta toimia vapaasti alemman asteen pappisasemassa ja nauttia kirkollista asemaa ilman oikeutta sakramentteihin (sine cura). Tapahtukoon niin (paavin penitentiariaatille myöntämien) erityisten (valtuuksien mukaan). Johannes S. Bernardi Vallensiksen apotti, sijaispenitentiaari.

sammendrag: Johannes, penitentiarians regens, abbot av San Bernardo (in Valldigna) The layman Jeppe Pedersson and Metta, the daughter of Olof Tavast, from the diocese of Turku, married despite knowing that they are related in the fourth degree of consanguinity and the fourth degree of affinity; the marriage was consummated. For this reason, they request absolution from excommunication and dispensation, so that they may remain in and renew the marriage and have their offspring considered legitimate. The petition is granted by the regent Johannes, bishop of Savona, and settled with the datary.
DF_source: Arkistolähteet: Vatikaani, Archivum Secretum Vaticanum, Archivio della Penitenzieria Apostolica, Reg. Matrim. et Divers.; Lähde-editiot: APS, #151.Auctoritate Papae. The Church Province of Uppsala and the Apostolic Penitentiary 1410–1526. Sara Risberg (edition), Kirsi Salonen (introduction). Stockholm: National Archives of Sweden 2008.
brevtekst:
(Penitentiarians) regens Johannes, biskop i Savona, beviljar tillsammans med datarian lekmannen Jeppe Pedersson och Metta, Olof Tavasts dotter, från Åbo stift, absolution och dispens. Jeppe och Metta gifte sig och fullbordade äktenskapet trots att de visste att de är släkt i fjärde led, varför de blev exkommunicerade. De får fortsätta vara gifta, och deras avkomma ska betraktas som legitim.
Ieppa Pedersson laicus et Metta filia Olavi Taffesten mulier coniuges Aboensis diocesis olim scientes se quarto consanguinitatis et quarto affinitatis gradu invicem fore coniunctos matrimonium inter se publice de facto contraxerunt carnali copula subsecuta, quare petunt a generali excommunicationis sententia, quam propter premissa incurrerunt, et excessibus huiusmodi absolvi necnon cum eisdem dispensari, ut impedimento huiusmodi non obstante in eorum sic contracto matrimonio remanere vel illud de novo contrahere possint cum legitimatione prolis suscepte, si qua sit, et suscipiende. Fiat de speciali et componat cum datario. Iohannes episcopus Saonensis regens etc.

sammendrag: Julianus, penitentiarians regens, abbot av San Sebastian The layman Nils Tavast and Margareta Sigfridsdotter, from the diocese of Turku, request permission to marry despite the fact that they are related in the third and fourth degrees of consanguinity. The regent Julianus, abbot of San Sebastian, grants the petition along with a letter of declaration (regarding the third and fourth degrees of consanguinity).

Nicolaus Tabast laicus Aboensis diocesis et Margareta filia Sifridi mulier dicte diocesis petunt, quatenus cum ipsis, ut non obstante, quod tertio et quarto consanguinitatis gradibus invicem sunt coniuncti, matrimonium inter se libere contrahere et in eo, postquam contractum fuerit, licite remanere possint, ut supra. sammendrag: Julianus, penitentiarians regens, abbot av San Sebastian Marcus Olavi, a priest from the diocese of Turku, was promoted to Holy Orders by a foreign bishop without a dimissorial letter when still under age and after the promulgation of the Cum ex sacrorum of Pope Pius II, whereupon he also served as a priest. He is now of proper age. The regent Julianus, abbot of San Sebastian, absolves Marcus.
DF_source: Arkistolähteet: Vatikaani, Archivum Secretum Vaticanum, Archivio della Penitenzieria Apostolica, Reg. Matrim. et Divers.; Lähde-editiot: APS, #154.Auctoritate Papae. The Church Province of Uppsala and the Apostolic Penitentiary 1410–1526. Sara Risberg (edition), Kirsi Salonen (introduction). Stockholm: National Archives of Sweden 2008.
brevtekst:
(Penitentiarians) regens Julianus, abbot i San Sebastian, beviljar Markus Olofsson, präst i Åbo stift, absolution för att ha låtit sig vigas till högre grader av en utländsk biskop utan tillstånd när han ännu inte hade uppnått rätt ålder, varefter han också har tjänstgjort. Han har nu rätt ålder inne.
Marcus Olavi presbyter Aboensis diocesis olim minor annis existens post constitutionem domini Pii pape ii, que incipit "Cum ex sacrorum ordinum etc.", se fecit sine litteris dimissoriis ab alieno episcopo gratiam et communionem sedis apostolice habente ad omnes sacros ordines promoveri et in ipsis ministravit. Petit igitur ab excommunicationum sententiis absolvi, quibus propter premissa incurrit tam per dictam constitutionem quam per constitutiones provinciales et synodales, quodque in suis ordinibus ministrare possit, cum nunc sit etatis legittime. Fiat de speciali. Iulianus abbas sancti Sebastiani regens etc.

sammendrag: Philippus, kardinalbiskop av Albano Olavus Mulle, a priest from the diocese of Turku, was out on business outside his residence but in his parish, when he met a parishioner and debtor of his, named Påvel. Olavus demanded that Påvel fulfil his promises and do some work for him, and he ordered him to go ahead with one of Olavus’s servants in the boat by which he had planned to return. Påvel agreed, but once he had entered the boat, he threw himself in the water as if he intended to flee, perhaps for fear of punishment for the serious crimes with which he was publicly charged. Olavus was not present in the boat when this happened, but in his granary, but as soon as he heard of it, he went to the shore to approach the layman and try to bring him back to the boat. Påvel disregarded his good advice and decided to swim towards an island with the intention of thwarting Olavus and what he had promised. While swimming away, Påvel suddenly drowned. Philippus, cardinal bishop of Albano, refers the case to the auditor Anthonius de Grassis for inspection and commissions the diocesan bishop to declare Olavus not irregular or disqualified, on condition that the facts above are true.
DF_source: Arkistolähteet: Vatikaani, Archivum Secretum Vaticanum, Archivio della Penitenzieria Apostolica, Reg. Matrim. et Divers.; Lähde-editiot: APS, #159.Auctoritate Papae. The Church Province of Uppsala and the Apostolic Penitentiary 1410–1526. Sara Risberg (edition), Kirsi Salonen (introduction). Stockholm: National Archives of Sweden 2008.
brevtekst:
Philippus, biskop i Albano, hänvisar en supplik till auditor Anthonius de Grassis för kontroll och ger i uppdrag åt biskopen i Åbo att förklara Olof Mulle, präst i Åbo stift, inte irregulär utan tillåten att tjänstgöra, under förutsättning att de uppgifter som lämnats är riktiga: Olof var ute på ett ärende i sin socken då han träffade en av sina gäldenärer och sockenbor, Påvel, som han uppmanade att betala sin skuld genom att utföra arbete åt honom. Påvel gick med på detta och skickades iväg tillsammans med en av Olofs tjänare i en båt, från vilken han kastade sig i vattnet som för att fly, kanske för att komma undan de anklagelser om allvarliga brott som riktade mot honom offentligt. Olof befann sig inte i båten utan i sitt spannmålsmagasin när detta hände, men begav sig till stranden så fort nyheten nått honom för att förmå lekmannen att återvända till båten. Påvel simmade trotsigt iväg mot en ö men drunknade plötsligt på vägen.
Olavus Mulle presbyter Aboensis diocesis exponit, quod, cum ipse olim certa die extra suam residentiam in limitibus tamen sue parrochie pro suis causis rationabilibus, licitis et honestis existeret ibique quendam Paulum laicum dicte diocesis suum in certis debitorem reperisset, ipsum, ut per operas et labores suos promissa per eum sibi satisfaceret, requisivit ac eum ad navigium, in quo exponens domum redire disposuerat, cum quodam suo familiari preire ordinavit; et dictus Paulus sponte fecit sed, postquam sponte navim intrasset, timore forsan alicuius punitionis vel pene propter gravia crimina et enormia, de quibus publice infamatus fuerat, de navigio ipsius exponentis per modum fuge ad fugandum dicto exponente non presente se in stagnum eiecit. Quod cum intelligeret prefatus exponens, qui, ut premittitur, tunc non in navigio sed in suo granario existeret, protinus eidem laico in occursum versus ripam venit. Ut de litore stanni, ad quod tunc natando devenerat et ad navigium, unde se eiecerat, rediret, bonis et salutaribus monitionibus inducere nitebatur. Laicus vero monitionibus et salutaribus persuasionibus ipsius exponentis contemptis – quo spiritu ductus nescitur sed, sicuti creditur, ut exponentem circa promissa huiusmodi supplantaret – versus quandam insulam se de imo ad natandum a litore disposuit, ubi subito natando submersus fuit et expiravit. Cum autem, pater sancte, exponens prefatus in mortem dicti laici aliter culpabilis non sit neque fuerit nec etiam ad hoc, quod submergeretur, auxilium consilium prestiterit vel favorem, a nonnullis tamen simplicibus etc. asseritur ipsum exponentem propter premissa irregularitatis maculam sive inhabilitatis notam contraxisse et propterea in suis ordinibus libere ministrare non posse. Ad ora igitur talium etc. obstruenda dignetur sanctitati vestre ipsum exponentem propter premissa nullam irregularitatis maculam sive inhabilitatis notam contraxisse sed ipsum premissis non obstantibus in suis ordinibus libere ministrare posse declarari mandare misericorditer dignemini ut in forma. Fiat ut infra. Philippus episcopus Albanensis. Videat eam dominus Anthonius de Grassis. Philippus. Comittatur ordinario et, si vocatis vocandis premissa vera esse invenerit et quod exponens in mortem prefati laici alias, quam ut premittitur, culpabilis non fuerit, declaret, ut petitur.

sammendrag: Antonius, penitentiarians regens, biskop av Luni Magnus Petri, a choral priest of Turku, was once on his way to visit a parish in Turku, when a layman, Peter Bengtsson, molested him and accused him of having taken one of his spurs. Peter drew his sword and attacked Magnus, who tried to talk calmly and then run away, but Peter continued his attacks. Magnus realized that he could not get away, and, fearing for his life, he grabbed his little sword, which he had held lifted to protect his head, and turned against the layman to defend himself and make Peter back off. In the fight Magnus’s left hand was injured, but he also wounded Peter, so that he died. When it became known that Peter had attacked Magnus, causing his own death, he was buried outside the cemetery in unconsecrated soil. The regent Antonius, bishop of Luni, refers the case to the auditor Anthonius de Grassis for inspection and commissions the diocesan bishop to declare Magnus innocent of homicide and not irregular or disqualified, on condition that the facts above are true.
DF_source: Arkistolähteet: Vatikaani, Archivum Secretum Vaticanum, Archivio della Penitenzieria Apostolica, Reg. Matrim. et Divers.; Lähde-editiot: APS, #175.Auctoritate Papae. The Church Province of Uppsala and the Apostolic Penitentiary 1410–1526. Sara Risberg (edition), Kirsi Salonen (introduction). Stockholm: National Archives of Sweden 2008.
brevtekst:
(Penitentiarians) regens Antonius, biskop i Luni, hänvisar en supplik till auditor Anthonius de Grassis för kontroll och ger i uppdrag åt biskopen i Åbo att förklara Magnus Petersson, korpräst i Åbo, oskyldig till mord och inte irregulär utan tillåten att tjänstgöra, under förutsättning att följande uppgifter är riktiga: På väg på ett besök blev han angripen med ett svärd av lekmannen Peter Bengtsson, som anklagade Magnus för att ha tagit en av hans sporrar. Magnus försökte både lugna Peter och fly, men när han insåg att det inte gick fruktade han för sitt liv och lyfte sitt lilla svärd och vände sig mot lekmannen. I striden som följde skadade Magnus sin hand men också Peter, som dog. När det blev känt att Peter hade angripit Magnus begravdes han utanför kyrkogården i ovigd jord.
Magnus Petri presbyter ac coralis ecclesie Aboensis exponit, quod [cum] olim quidam Petrus Benedicti laicus et civis Aboensis, cum exponens, qui ad certum locum sive parrochiam Aboensis diocesis utputa suos visitaret, accesserat veniens in via, exponentem ipsum, quod calcar unum, quod perdiderat, haberet, plurimum licet falso increpasset eumque, licet indebite, quoniam exponens illud non habuerat, vehementer molestasset. Et demum de inculpatione et molestatione predictis non contentus dyabolo instigante in exponentem evaginato gladio irruens ipsum continuo fugientem / et predicto laico cum mansuetudine respondentem insequi non cessabat. Exponens vero, ut manus ipsius layci evaderet et daret locum furori, paululum a via declinavit; laycus tamen non minus exponentem ipsum infestabat. Animadvertens tandem idem exponens se fuga huiusmodi manus dicti layci evadere non posse timensque sibi mortis periculum imminere gladiolum suum, quem in fuga pro capitis defensione tenuerat supra caput, ad insequentem se conversus gratia ictus excipiendi eidem layco opponebat et sic longo conflictu vim vi repellendo et se defendendo ac in sinistra manu sua vulnere accepto dictum laicum etiam in manu vulneravit adeo, quod postea ex eodem vulnere expiravit; et demum constito, quod in exponentem irruerat ac proprie mortis causa fuerat, in terra prophana extra cimiterium sepultus extitit. Cum autem dictus exponens de morte dicti laici ab intimis doluerit doleatque de presenti cupiatque in suis ordinibus perpetuo Domino famulari, a nonnullis etc. asseritur ipsum propter premissa homicidii reatum incurrisse et irregularitatis maculam sive inhabilitatis notam contraxisse ac in dictis ordinibus licite ministrare non posse. Ad ora igitur talium etc. obstruenda supplicat etc., quatenus ipsum premissorum occasione nullum homicidii reatum incurrisse nullamque irregularitatis maculam sive inhabilitatis notam contraxisse sed premissis non obstantibus in dictis ordinibus libere et licite alio sibi non obstante canonico ministrare posse declarari mandare dignemini ut in forma. Fiat ut infra. Antonius episcopus Lunensis regens etc. Videat eam dominus Anthonius de Grassis. Antonius. Comittatur ordinario et, si vocatis vocandis sibi constiterit, quod exponens vim vi reppellendo et se deffendendo aliter fugere seu mortem evadere non valens percussit, ut prefertur, et de aliis expositis, declaret, ut petitur.

sammendrag: Laurentius, penitentiarians regens, biskop av Arezzo Johannes Philippi, a priest and monk in the Birgittine monastery of Naantali (Nådendal) in the diocese of Turku, had been appointed father confessor by his superior to the sisters in another monastery of the same order and diocese, and often heard their confessions. On several occasions he entered the convent and had sexual intercourse with two of the nuns, who were related to each other in the third degree of consanguinity. Johannes fears that he has thus incurred excommunication, but he has still officiated. He requests to be absolved from the sins of incest and fornication and to be dispensed from irregularity. The regent Laurentius, bishop of Arezzo, grants the petition.
DF_source: Arkistolähteet: Vatikaani, Archivum Secretum Vaticanum, Archivio della Penitenzieria Apostolica, Reg. Matrim. et Divers.; Lähde-editiot: APS, #180.Auctoritate Papae. Som biktfar för birgittinsystrarna kunde han flera gånger träda in i systrakonventet, där han hade sexuellt umgänge med två av nunnorna, som var släkt med varandra i tredje led. Johan fortsatte tjänstgöra trots att han fruktade att han blivit exkommunicerad.

sammendrag: Angelus, penitentiarians regens, biskop av Bagnorea Haquinus Frille, a priest from the diocese of Turku, once attacked an acolyte, although without any bloodshed or major violation. He thus incurred excommunication. Despite not being absolved, and before the promulgation of the Cum ex sacrorum of Pope Pius II, he was promoted to minor orders. He served in them both before and after said constitution, for which reason he was also suspended. The regent Angelus, bishop of Bagnorea, grants Haquinus absolution and dispensation.
DF_source: Arkistolähteet: Vatikaani, Archivum Secretum Vaticanum, Archivio della Penitenzieria Apostolica, Reg. Matrim. et Divers.; Lähde-editiot: APS, #193.Auctoritate Papae. Utan att ha mottagit absolution, och före Pius II:s bulla "Cum ex sacrorum", lät han sig vigas till högre grader och tjänstgjorde, trots att han dessutom var minderårig.

Fiat de speciali. Angelus episcopus Balneoregiensis regens.

sammendrag: Julianus, kardinalbiskop av San Pietro in Vincoli Lambertus Lamberti, a priest from the diocese of Turku, once accepted a young boy into his household and taught him to read and write, so that he could be of service to Lambertus in his duties and in celebrating the Divine Office. One day Lambertus disciplined the boy. The following night, the boy jumped from his window in fear of being whipped. The next morning he was found dead, because of the severe cold prevailing in those parts. Julianus, cardinal priest of San Pietro in Vincoli, refers the case to the auditor Anthonius de Grassis for inspection and commissions the diocesan bishop to declare Lambertus innocent of homicide and not irregular or disqualified, on condition that the facts above are true.
DF_source: Arkistolähteet: Vatikaani, Archivum Secretum Vaticanum, Archivio della Penitenzieria Apostolica, Reg. Matrim. et Divers.; Lähde-editiot: APS, #235.Auctoritate Papae. The Church Province of Uppsala and the Apostolic Penitentiary 1410–1526. Sara Risberg (edition), Kirsi Salonen (introduction). Stockholm: National Archives of Sweden 2008.
brevtekst:
Julianus, kardinalpräst i San Pietro in Vincoli, hänvisar en supplik till auditor Anthonius de Grassis för kontroll och ger i uppdrag åt biskopen i Åbo att förklara Lambert Lambertsson, präst i Åbo stift, oskyldig till mord och inte irregulär utan tillåten att tjänstgöra, förutsatt att följande uppgifter stämmer: Lambert tog en gång emot en ung pojke i sitt hushåll och lärde honom läsa och skriva, så att han kunde vara till hjälp i Lamberts tjänstgöring. En dag bestraffade Lambert pojken. Följande natt hoppade pojken ut från sitt sovrumsfönster av rädsla för att bli piskad. På morgonen hittades han död på grund av den starka kyla som rådde.
Lambertus Lamberti presbyter Aboensis diocesis exponit, quod, cum ipse olim quendam iuvenem Dei dilectione et causa misericordie in familiarem suum accepisset, ut eundem iuvenem litteris instrueret ac sibi in omnibus honestis neccessariisque et maximis divinis officiis servivisset, una die contingente dictum iuvenem virgis discipline correctionis verberasset. Et dictus iuvenis propter timorem discipline domino suo nesciente et ignorante tempore noctis in domo, in qua dormivisset, nescitur quo spiritu ductus, per fenestram extra saltasset et ibidem magno frigore secundum regionem illius patrie, ubi frigus maxime vigeret, mortuus est repertus. Cum autem dictus exponens de morte ipsius iuvenis valde doluerit prout dolet de presenti cupiatque in omnibus suis ordinibus ministrare, a nonnullis tamen simplicibus et iurisignaris ac ipsius exponentis forsan emulis asseritur ipsum propter premissa homicidii reatum incurrisse et irregularitatis maculam sive inhabilitatis notam contraxisse et propterea in suis ordinibus ministrare non posse. Ad ora igitur talium et aliorum sibi super hoc in futurum forsan obloqui volentium emulorum obstruenda supplicat dictus exponens, quatenus ipsum exponentem premissis non obstantibus nullam irregularitatis maculam sive inhabilitatis notam contraxisse et in omnibus suis ordinibus ministrare posse et valere declarare dignemini. Fiat ut infra. Iulianus tituli Sancti Petri ad Vincula. Videat eam dominus Anthonius de Grassis. Iulianus. Committatur ordinario, et, si vocatis vocandis premissa vera esse invenerit et, quod exponens in correctione modum non excesserit nec alias, quam ut premittitur, in morte dicti iuvenis culpabilis fuerit, declaret, ut petitur.

sammendrag: Antonius, penitentiarians regens, biskop av Luni The layman Sten Henriksson and Anna Jakobsdotter, from the diocese of Turku, contracted and consummated their marriage knowing they were related twice in the fourth degree of affinity. They request to be absolved from excommunication, permitted to remain married and to have their offspring considered legitimate. The petition is granted and settled with the datary by the regent Antonius, bishop of Luni.

brevtekst:
(Penitentiarians) regens Antonius, biskop i Luni, beviljar Sten Henriksson (Renhufvud) och Anna Jakobsdotter (Kurki) från Åbo stift absolution för att ha ingått och fullbordat sitt äktenskap i vetskap om att de är släkt två gånger i fjärde led och därmed blivit exkommunicerade. De får fortsätta vara gifta, och deras avkomma ska betraktas som legitim. Suppliken beviljas i samråd med datarian.
Steno Henrici laicus et Antiorina Iacobi mulier coniuges Aboensis diocesis olim scientes se quarto et quarto affinitatis gradibus invicem attinere matrimonium inter se per verba de presenti publice de facto contraxerunt illudque carnali copula consumarunt. Petunt, quatenus ipsos a generali excommunicationis sententia, quam propter premissa incurrerunt, absolvi cum ipsisque, ut premissis non obstantibus in eorum sic contracto matrimonio remanere possent, dispensari mandare dignemini prolem susceptam, si qua sit, et suscipiendam legitimam decernentes. Fiat de speciali et componat cum datario. Antonius episcopus Lunensis regens.

sammendrag: Julianus, kardinalbiskop av San Pietro in Vincoli The layman Nils Larsson and Katarina Johansdotter, from the diocese of Turku, wish to marry, but, since they are twice related in the fourth degree of consanguinity, they cannot fulfil their wish without apostolic dispensation. Therefore, they request such a dispensation, so that they may marry and have their offspring considered legitimate. Their supplication is granted by Julianus, cardinal priest of San Pietro in Vincoli.

Nicolaus Laurentii laicus et Catherina filia Iohannis mulier Aboensis diocesis ipsi ex certis causis rationabilibus desiderant invicem matrimonialiter copulari, sed quia quarto et quarto consanguinitatis gradibus invicem sunt coniuncti, desiderium eorum adimplere non possunt sine dispensatione. Supplicant, quatenus cum ipsis, ut premissis non obstantibus matrimonium inter se contrahere et in eo post contractum remanere licite possint, dispensari dignemini prolem suscipiendam exinde legitimam decernentes de gratia speciali. Fiat de speciali. Iulianus tituli Sancti Petri ad Vincula.

sammendrag: Julianus, kardinalbiskop av San Pietro in Vincoli Franciscus Karoli, a Franciscan priest and friar from Uppsala, formerly lived in the convent of Viborg (Viipuri) in the diocese of Turku, where once a fellow brother was attacked by a layman with a sword, so that he fell to the ground. As the layman persisted in his attacks, Franciscus seized a crossbow, without intending to hurt the layman but to prevent him from killing his fellow brother. Raising the weapon, he told the layman to cease attacking the brother or he would suffer. The layman then aimed his sword at Franciscus and tried to strike him. The supplicant, fearing for his life, held the crossbow in front of him to defend himself and accidentally shot an arrow, which hit the layman on the jaw. The layman died from the wound. Julianus, cardinal priest of San Pietro in Vincoli, refers the case to the auditor Anthonius de Grassis for inspection and commissions the diocesan bishop to declare Franciscus innocent of homicide and not irregular or disqualified, on condition that the facts above are true.

The Church Province of Uppsala and the Apostolic Penitentiary 1410–1526. Sara Risberg (edition), Kirsi Salonen (introduction). Stockholm: National Archives of Sweden 2008.
brevtekst:
Julianus, kardinalpräst i San Pietro in Vincoli, hänvisar en supplik till auditor Anthonius de Grassis för kontroll och ger i uppdrag åt biskopen i Uppsala att förklara broder Frans Karlsson, franciskanpräst i Uppsala, oskyldig till mord och inte irregulär utan tillåten att tjänstgöra, förutsatt att följande uppgifter stämmer: Frans levde tidigare i konventet i Viborg i Åbo stift. Där blev en gång en medbroder angripen av en lekman med ett svärd så att han föll till marken. Lekmannen fortsatte sina angrepp, varpå Frans, utan avsikt att skada, grep ett armborst för att hindra lekmannen att döda medbrodern. Lekmannen riktade sitt svärd mot Frans i stället, som i självförsvar höjde armborstet och råkade skjuta iväg en pil som träffade lekmannen i käken. Lekmannen dog av skadan.
Frater Franciscus Karoli presbyter professus conventus Upsalensis ordinis fratrum minorum exponit, quod, cum ipse olim in quodam alio conventu Viborgensi eiusdem ordinis Aboensis diocesis existeret et quidam laicus certum ipsius exponentis socium fratrem eiusdem ordinis gladio evaginato invasisset adeo, quod dictus frater retrocedendo in terram ceciderat, ac alias eundem in terra iacentem insequeretur, dictus exponens quandam balistam dicto laico pertinentem non tamen animo aliquem offendendi sed potius laicum predictum, ne eius socium confratrem interficeret et <ut> a persecutione huiusmodi desisteret, terrendi manibus arripuit ac eam extendendo telum inposuit et ad ipsum laicum dixit "Desinas fratrem meum amplius prosequi et molestari, vel alias te male tractabo". Quo dicto prefatus laicus dimisso fratre ipsius exponentis volens dicto exponenti apropinquare quendam gladium contra ipsum levavit satagens cum eodem ipsum exponentem verberare. Quod videns dictus exponens timens sibi mortis periculum imminere vel alias enormiter offendi balistam huiusmodi extensam pro defensione manu sua sinistra dumtaxat ante caput suum tenuit ita, quod preter ipsius exponentis voluntatem dicta balista sagittam emisit et casualiter dictum laicum in maxilla taliter lesit, quod ex huiusmodi lesione postmodum diem suum clausit extremum. Cum autem dictus exponens in mortem dicti laici minime aspiraverit et alias, quam ut premittitur, de morte ipsius culpabilis non fuerit ymo de ea valde doluerit, prout dolet de presenti, cupiatque in omnibus suis ordinibus perpetuo Domino famulari, ab aliquibus tamen simplicibus et iurisignaris ac ipsius exponentis forsan emulis in eum labia detraxionis aperire volentibus asseritur ipsum propter premissa homicidii reatum incurrisse et irregularitatis maculam sive inhabilitatis notam contraxisse et propterea in omnibus suis ordinibus ministrare non posse. Ad ora igitur talium et aliorum sibi super hoc in futurum forsan obloqui volentium emulorum obstruenda supplicat sanctitati vestre dictus exponens, quatenus ipsum premissorum occasione nullum homicidii reatum incurrisse, maculam irregularitatis nullam sive inhabilitatis notam contraxisse, sed quod libere et licite in omnibus suis ordinibus ministrare possit et valeat, misericorditer declarare dignemini ut in forma. Fiat ut infra. Iulianus tituli Sancti Petri ad Vincula. Videat eam dominus Anthonius de Grassis. Committatur ordinario et, si vocatis vocandis sibi constiterit, quod exponens vim vi repellendo et se defendendo aliter fugere seu mortem evadere non valeret balistam tenuerit, ut prefertur, et de aliis expositis, declaret, ut petitur.

sammendrag: Julianus, kardinalbiskop av San Pietro in Vincoli Petrus Nicolai, a Franciscan priest of the convent of Rauma (Raumo) in the diocese of Turku, was one evening on his way to close the gates, as was his duty, when two of the younger brothers accompanying him attacked him, threw him to the ground and injured his shoulders. In fear of being killed, Petrus took out a small knife to defend himself, to frighten off his attackers, and to free himself, but not to hurt any of them. When some other brothers appeared, the attackers, who were also rebelling against the convent and the superiors, fled and then brawled throughout the night. The next morning, one of the rebels was found dead from a wound that an unknown assailant had given him. Julianus, cardinal priest of San Pietro in Vincoli, refers the case to (the auditor) the bishop of Nocera for inspection and commissions the diocesan bishop to declare Petrus innocent of homicide and not irregular or disqualified, on condition that the facts above are true.

Julianus, kardinalpräst i San Pietro in Vincoli, hänvisar en supplik till biskopen i Nocera för kontroll och ger i uppdrag åt biskopen i Åbo att förklara Peter Nilsson, präst i franciskankonventet i Rauma i Åbo stift, oskyldig till mord och inte irregulär utan tillåten att tjänstgöra, förutsatt att följande uppgifter stämmer: Peter var en kväll på väg att stänga portarna när två av hans yngre medbröder angrep honom. Peter fruktade för sitt liv och drog fram en liten kniv för att försvara sig och utan avsikt att skada någon. När andra bröder dök upp flydde angriparna, som var upprorsmakare gentemot konventet och dess överordnade, men fortsatte slåss sinsemellan under natten. Morgonen därpå hittades en av upprorsmakarna död, sårad av en okänd angripare.
Petrus Nicolai presbyter professor ordinis fratrum minorum conventus Rawmensis Aboensis diocesis exponit, quod, cum ipse olim die quodam hora serotina portas sui conventus, prout ad eum huiusmodi exercitium in dicto conventu ex iniuncto sibi a superioribus suis officio spectabat, claudere vellet, duo fratres eiusdem conventus de iunioribus, qui eidem exponenti [sibi] comitabantur, exponentem ipsum, nescitur quo animo nisi maligno, invaserunt illumque ad terram tertia vice prostraverunt et eum in humeris vulnerarunt. Exponens vero sic probatus timens mortis periculum sibi imminere, prout imminebat, quendam parvum cultrum ad modum †scindi pennium† vim vi repellendo et se defendendo – aliter mortem evitare non posse credens – aliquantulum, ut eisdem vim sibi inferentibus timorem incuteret et se ab eorum manibus liberaret (non tamen ut aliquem ex eis lederet), eduxit illumque hincinde movit. Et sic supervenientibus aliquibus aliis de fratribus dicti conventus illi sibi vim inferentes, qui etiam conventus sui et suorum superiorum rebelles erant, [ac] aufugerunt et postmodum inter se certarunt nocte illa. Deinde mane iam facto eorundem rebellum alter mortuus inventus ex quodam parvo vulnere et nescitur a quo illatum existit. Cum autem dictus exponens alias, quam ut premittitur, de morte dicti fratris culpabilis non fuerit de morteque eius doluerit valde, prout dolet de presenti, cupiatque in omnibus suis ordinibus licite ministrare et altissimo Domino famulari, a nonnullis tamen simplicibus et iurisignaris ac ipsius forsan exponentis emulis asseritur ipsum propter premissa homicidii reatum incurrisse et irregularitatis maculam sive inhabilitatis notam contraxisse ac in dictis ordinibus licite ministrare non posse. Ad ora igitur talium et aliorum sibi super hoc in futurum obloqui volentium obstruenda emulorum supplicatur etc., quatenus ipsum premissorum occasione nullum homicidii reatum incurrisse nullam irregularitatis maculam sive inhabilitatis notam [non] contraxisse sed premissis non obstantibus in dictis ordinibus libere et licite alio sibi non obstante canonico ministrare posse declarare dignemini ut in forma. Fiat ut in forma. Iulianus tituli Sancti Petri ad Vincula. Videat eam dominus Nucerinus. Iulianus. Committatur ordinario et, si vocatis vocandis invenerit, quod vim vi repellendo et se defendendo aliter fugere seu mortem evitare non valens exponens <cultrum> †scindi penidiur† eduxerit et moverit ac de aliis expositis, declaret, ut petitur.

sammendrag: Julianus, penitentiarians regens, biskop av Bertinoro The layman Peder Lille and Barbara Olofsdotter, from the diocese of Turku, contracted and consummated their marriage knowing that they were related in the threefold third and fourth degrees of affinity. They request absolution from excommunication and incest, dispensation to remain married and legitimation of their offspring. The regent Julianus, bishop of Bertinoro, grants the petition along with a letter of declaration regarding the third and fourth degrees of affinity
DF_source: Arkistolähteet: Vatikaani, Archivum Secretum Vaticanum, Archivio della Penitenzieria Apostolica, Reg. Matrim. et Divers.; Lähde-editiot: APS, #266.Auctoritate Papae. (Penitentiarians) regens Julianus, biskop i Bertinoro, beviljar lekmannen Peder Lille och Barbara Olofsdotter från Åbo stift absolution och dispens att förbli gifta och få sin avkomma betraktad som legitim, trots att de ingick och fullbordade sitt äktenskap i vetskap om att de var besläktade tre gånger i tredje och fjärde led.
Petrus Lille laicus et Barbara Olavi mulier coniuges Aboensis diocesis exponunt, quod ipsi scienter in triplici tertio et quarto affinitatis gradibus, quibus se attinent, matrimonium per verba de presenti contraxerunt illudque carnali copula consumarunt. Petunt absolvi a generali excommunicationis sententia ac reatu incestus huiusmodi ac cum ipsis dispensari de remanendo cum legitimatione prolis suscepte, si qua sit, et exinde suscipiende de gratia speciali. Fiat de speciali. Iulianus episcopus Brictonoriensis regens. Et cum litteris declaratoriis ut in forma. Fiat. Iulianus.

sammendrag: Julianus, penitentiarians regens, biskop av Bertinoro Magnus Petri, a priest in the diocese of Turku, present in the Roman curia, explains that he once met a Dominican lay-brother, who had held Magnus’s nephew hidden in his cell. In sudden anger he hit this man, although without causing bodily harm. He was therefore excommunicated but nevertheless officiated. The regent Julianus, bishop of Bertinoro, absolves Magnus and dispenses him from irregularity.
DF_source: Arkistolähteet: Vatikaani, Archivum Secretum Vaticanum, Archivio della Penitenzieria Apostolica, Reg. Matrim. et Divers.; Lähde-editiot: APS, #268.Auctoritate Papae. (Penitentiarians) regens Julianus, biskop i Bertinoro beviljar Magnus Petersson, präst i Åbo stift och närvarande i kurian, absolution och dispens från exkommunicering, som han ådrog sig för att i vredesmod, men utan att orsaka någon kroppslig skada, slagit en dominikanbroder som hållit Magnus brorson gömd i sin cell. Magnus tjänstgjorde också trots exkommuniceringen.
Magnus Petri presbyter Aboensis diocesis in curia sanctitatis vestre presens exponit, quod, dum olim ipse exponens quendam conversum conventus ordinis predicatorum Aboensis, qui in sua cella dicti conventus quendam puerum dicti exponentis nepotem, quo spiritu ductus nescitur, occultatum detinebat, in publico foro civitatis Aboensis obvium haberet, impetu ire, quam ipse exponens concepit, in dictum conversum manus suas iniecit seu posuit absque tamen corporis sui lesione. Propter quod excommunicationis sententiam in tales generaliter promulgatam incurrit; et sic ligatus tamquam simplex et non in contemptum clavium divina celebravit et alias se immiscuit eisdem. Supplicat, quatenus ipsum a dicta sententia et excessibus huiusmodi absolvi secumque super irregularitate dicto modo contracta dispensari mandare misericorditer dignemini de gratia speciali. Fiat de speciali. Iulianus episcopus Brictonoriensis regens.

sammendrag: Julianus, penitentiarians regens, biskop av Bertinoro Thomas Laurentii, a priest from the diocese of Turku, violently attacked a cleric and a layman, although not excessively nor with any bloodshed, and thus incurred excommunication, during which he took part in the Divine Office. The regent Julianus, bishop of Bertinoro, refers the case to one of the minor penitentiaries at St Peter’s and commissions him to absolve Thomas from irregularity and any other sins.
DF_source: Arkistolähteet: Vatikaani, Archivum Secretum Vaticanum, Archivio della Penitenzieria Apostolica, Reg. Matrim. et Divers.; Lähde-editiot: APS, #272.Auctoritate Papae. Thomas Laurentii presbyter Aboensis diocesis exponit, quod [cum] ipse olim manus violentas in quendam clericum et quendam laicum citra tamen sanguinis effusionem et absque alio excessu difficili iniecit, propter quod excommunicationis incurrit sententiam in tales generaliter promulgatam; nec in contemptum clavium se immiscuit in divinis. Petit absolvi super irregularitate, si qua sit, et ab aliis suis excessibus de gratia speciali. Iulianus episcopus Brictonoriensis regens. Et committatur in Sancto Petro uni ex penitentiariis minoribus. Fiat. Iulianus.

sammendrag: Franciscus, penitentiarians regens, biskop av Anagni Andreas “Lanxii”, a cleric from the diocese of Turku, once had supper with some other clerics at a house in Turku when two laymen broke down the door and attacked them. The clerics found themselves confined and unable to climb the high walls of the house to get away. Fearing both that further invaders might prepare for another attack and that the first two invaders might be able to escape, the clerics leapt outside the door. In the street outside the clerics found the two laymen so heavily armed that they could not be avoided without danger. Since the clerics had nothing to defend themselves with, Andreas took a stone from the ground and threw it at one of the invaders, Olof Karlsson, who was wounded in the head and died a few hours later. The regent Franciscus, bishop of Anagni, commissions the diocesan bishop to declare Andreas innocent of homicide and not irregular or disqualified, on condition that the facts above are true.
DF_source: Arkistolähteet: Vatikaani, Archivum Secretum Vaticanum, Archivio della Penitenzieria Apostolica, Reg. Matrim. et Divers.; Lähde-editiot: APS, #289.Auctoritate Papae. The Church Province of Uppsala and the Apostolic Penitentiary 1410–1526. Sara Risberg (edition), Kirsi Salonen (introduction). Stockholm: National Archives of Sweden 2008.
brevtekst:
(Penitentiarians) regens Franciscus, biskop i Anagni, ger i uppdrag åt biskopen i Åbo att förklara Anders "Lanxii", klerk i Åbo stift, oskyldig till mord och inte irregulär utan tillåten att tjänstgöra, på villkor att följande uppgifter stämmer: Anders åt middag med några andra klerker i ett hus i Åbo när två lekmän bröt sig in genom dörren och angrep dem. Då klerkerna fruktade ytterligare angrepp och att de två första angriparna skulle komma undan hoppade de ut genom dörren. På gatan mötte de två så tungt beväpnade lekmän att de inte kunde undkomma dem utan fara för livet. Klerkerna hade inget att försvara sig med, men Anders plockade upp en sten från marken och kastade den på en av angriparna, Olof Karlsson, som sårades i huvudet och avled några timmar senare.
Andreas Lanxii clericus Aboensis diocesis exponit, quod dudum ipse unacum certis aliis clericis certo die de sero in quadam domo in civitate Aboensis sita collationem fecisset. Quidam laici duo, nescitur quo spiritu ducti, cum armis portam dicte domus obruerunt animo invadendi eosdem. Cumque exponens et predicti clerici se undique fore constrictos et menia illius domus ob illorum altitudinem conscendere pro illarum fuga capienda non posse animadvertissent timentesque timore, qui in constantem virum cadere potest, et plures invasores cum duobus invadentibus illis ad denuo eosdem invadendum congregari et interim etiam predictos duos invasores abiisse et ab illis evadere posse exponens aliique clerici predicti extra portam dicte domus exilierunt. Et cum in strata publica forent, eosdem laicos cum armis invenerunt adeo, quod neutro eorum sub periculis corporum eorum declinare poterant. Dictus exponens animo <se> defendendi et non alias vim vi repellendo neccesse fore animadvertit et, cum aliud clerici et exponens predicti, quo se defenderent, penes se non haberent, ipse exponens cum lapide, quem de humo reprehendit, quendam Olavum Karlsan unum ex laicis invasoribus predictis, dum adhuc viveret, et in illius anteriori parte capitis sui proiecit et vulneravit; qui tandem ex illo vulnere infra aliquas horas diem suum clausit extremum. Cum autem dictus exponens in morte dicti Olavi alias, quam ut premittitur, culpabilis non fuerit sed de morte doluerit cupiatque ex magno devotionis fervore dicto clericali caractere uti et ad omnes sacros et presbyteratus ordines promoveri etc., ab aliquibus tamen simplicibus et iurisignaris asseritur dictum exponentem propter premissa homicidii reatum incurrisse et irregularitatis maculam incurrisse sive inhabilitatis notam contraxisse etc. Ad ora igitur talium obstruenda petit exponens, quatenus ipsum premissorum occasione nullum homicidii reatum incurrisse nullamque irregularitatis maculam contraxisse sed premissis non obstantibus dicto suo clericali caractere uti et ad omnes sacros ordines promoveri, licite remanere et ministrare posse declarari misericorditer mandare dignemini prout in forma. Fiat ut infra. Franciscus episcopus Ananiensis regens. Committatur ordinario, et, si vocatis vocandis sibi constiterit, quod dictus exponens vim vi repellendo alias aufugere seu evadere seu defendendo non poterat, nisi dictum Olavum vulnerasset, et de aliis expositis, declaret, ut petitur.

sammendrag: Franciscus, penitentiarians regens, biskop av Anagni Magnus Johannis, a priest from the diocese of Turku, went out of his mind from the plague and severe pain when, on his friends’ suggestion and not by reason, he made a vow to enter a monastery if he was rescued from his illness. He recovered but did not acknowledge the vow his friends told him about, since he did not remember it. Magnus requests to have this vow changed to another pious act. The regent Franciscus, bishop of Anagni, grants the petition.
DF_source: Arkistolähteet: Vatikaani, Archivum Secretum Vaticanum, Archivio della Penitenzieria Apostolica, Reg. Matrim. et Divers.; Lähde-editiot: APS, #290.Auctoritate Papae. The Church Province of Uppsala and the Apostolic Penitentiary 1410–1526. Sara Risberg (edition), Kirsi Salonen (introduction). Stockholm: National Archives of Sweden 2008.
brevtekst:
(Penitentiarians) regens Franciscus, biskop i Anagni, beviljar Magnus Johansson, präst i Åbo stift, tillstånd att ändra ett avgivet löfte till en annan from handling. Magnus var vansinnig av pestsjukdom och svår smärta, när han på förslag från sina vänner och inte förnuftsmässigt avgav ett löfte att gå i kloster om han blev frisk. Han tillfrisknade men mindes inte det löfte vännerna berättade om.
Magnus Iohannis presbyter Aboensis diocesis <exponit, quod, cum> quadam pestifera infirmitate et ex vehementi dolore demens fuisset, sugestione quorundam amicorum circumstantium et non iudicio rationis vovit, ut, si ab hac infirmitate liberaretur, aliquam ex religionibus approbatis ingrediretur. Deinde bene convaluit et voti inmemor nisi ex relatione dictorum amicorum nec eundem ratum neque gratum habuit. Petit, <quatenus> votum huiusmodi in alia pietatis opera mutari mandare dignemini de gratia speciali. Fiat de speciali et expresso. Franciscus episcopus Ananiensis regens.

sammendrag: Benedictus, penitentiarians regens, domprost i Rimini Thomas Olavi, vicar of the parish church in Savo (Savolax) in the diocese of Turku, once beat his servant Jakob two or three times with a kind of rope that is commonly used for bow-strings, after Jakob one evening had failed to give him the vessel used to carry grain in to feed the horses. Jakob was not hurt, but hit back with a sieve and put his hands around Thomas’s neck. Thomas tore away the hands and escaped his house and Jakob’s fury. Jakob followed Thomas and caught him, but during the fight Thomas threw Jakob to the ground. Jakob then clawed Thomas’s face with his fingers, and Thomas bit one of Jakob’s fingers until it was blue, but without causing any bloodshed. Other people intervened and separated the two assailants, who made their peace. Jakob begged Thomas’s forgiveness, which was granted, and he took up his previous work again. He worked for three weeks as before and said that he had no trouble with his finger. Then his right hand became swollen, probably because of neglect, and an incompetent doctor cut up the hand from inside and out. At the moment of his death, Jakob himself claimed in front of witnesses that this cut was the reason for his death, excusing Thomas from any responsibility. The regent Benedictus, provost of Rimini, refers the case to the diocesan bishop and commissions him to declare Thomas innocent and not irregular, on condition that the facts above are true.
DF_source: Arkistolähteet: Vatikaani, Archivum Secretum Vaticanum, Archivio della Penitenzieria Apostolica, Reg. Matrim. et Divers.; Lähde-editiot: APS, #292.Auctoritate Papae. The Church Province of Uppsala and the Apostolic Penitentiary 1410–1526. Sara Risberg (edition), Kirsi Salonen (introduction). Stockholm: National Archives of Sweden 2008.
brevtekst:
(Penitentiarians) regens Benedictus, domprost i Rimini, ger i uppdrag åt biskopen i Åbo att förklara Tomas Olofsson, kyrkoherde i Savolax i Åbo stift, oskyldig (till mord) och inte irregulär, på villkor att följande uppgifter stämmer: Tomas slog en gång sin tjänare Jakob med ett slags rep, som brukar användas till bågsträngar, för att han inte hade gett honom ett kärl att utfodra hästarna med. Jakob blev inte skadad utan slog tillbaka och lade sina händer runt halsen på Tomas, som slet bort dem och flydde. Jakob följde dock efter, och det uppstod ett slagsmål där Tomas kastade Jakob till marken, Jakob klöste Tomas i ansiktet, och Tomas bet Jakob i ett finger tills det var blått, men utan att blodvite uppstod. Andra människor gick emellan och skilde slagskämparna åt. Jakob bad Tomas om förlåtelse, Tomas förlät honom, och Jakob återupptog sitt arbete. Under tre veckor arbetade han som vanligt och sa att han inte hade några problem med sitt finger. Sedan svullnade högerhanden upp, troligtvis på grund av försummelse, och en oduglig läkare skar upp (av?) handen. I dödsögonblicket hävdade Jakob i vittnens närvaro att detta var orsaken till hans död och att Tomas var fri från allt ansvar.
Thomas Olavi presbyter rector parrochialis ecclesie Sawalax Aboensis diocesis exponit, quod, cum olim certo die de sero in crepusculo seu quasi quondam Iacobus, dum adhuc viveret, familiaris suus quoddam vas ad ferendum in eo bladum equis suis et ad illos pasendum iussu exponentis sibi presentare distullisset, ipseque exponens dictum Iacobum cum quadam corda, uti in arcu manuali solita est habere, bis vel ter absque tamen lesione percussit. Iacobus vero dictum exponentem cum cribro repercussiens et ulterius manus eius violentas [eius] in dicti exponentis collum eum perstringens iniecit, quas ipse exponens ex ipsius collo suis manibus evulsit; et sic furiam illius extra domum suam evasit et auffugit. Quem dictus Iacobus insecutus iterum apprehendit, et illis invicem colluctantibus exponens Deo volente Iacobum in humum prostravit. Dum vero ille Iacobus subtus exponente prostratus iacens digitis manuum suarum exponentem in eius facie sauciavit, ille exponens dentibus suis tertium ex articulis manus illius Iacobi dextre apprehendit et vim vi repellere volens tenuit usque ad illius articuli lividitatem absque sanguinis effusione. Deinde illis nonnullis aliis intervenientibus ab invicem separatis in crastinumque reconsiliatis dictus Iacobus a dicto exponente veniam exposcens et obtinens priores labores suos domesticos uti familiaris exponentis perantea solitos resumpsit; et laboribus istis ad tres quasi septimanas prout perantea insistens nec quitquam debilitatis seu defectus occasione dicti digiti se habere dixit. Nichilominus diebus istis elapsis, dum forsan potius ex illius incuria manus dextra eiusdem tumesceret, quidam cirogicus minime in arte expeditus illius Iacobi manum dextram predictam intus et ab extra incidit. Ex qua, ut verius creditur, incisione <exspiravit>, uti et dictus Iacobus in ultimis suis a dicto exponente in presentia testium fidedignorum inquisitus eidem et omnibus audientibus publice respondit et dixit dictum exponentem excusando, quod ille nequaquam mortis sue emminentis <causa fuit>, sed incusando dictum medicum, qui eum inconsulte incidit, causam fore. Demum vero dictus Iacobus expiravit. Cum autem / dictus exponens in morte dicti Iacobi alias, quam ut premittitur, culpabilis non fuerit ymo de ipsius morte doluerit cupiatque in omnibus etiam presbyteratus ordinibus ministrare posse, a nonnullis etc. Ad ora talium obstruenda supplicat, quatenus ipsum premissorum occasione nullum homicidii reatum incurrisse nullamque irregularitatis maculam contraxisse sed premissis non obstantibus in omnibus etiam presbyteratus ordinibus ministrare posse declarari misericorditer mandare dignemini prout in forma. Fiat ut infra. Benedictus prepositus Ariminensis regens. Committatur ordinario, et, si vocatis vocandis constiterit de premissis, declaret, ut petitur.

I marg.: Rome apud Sanctum Petrum; Anno secundo Innocentii pape viii; Rome v Idus Ianuarii; Abuoensis diocesis

sammendrag: Julianus, penitentiarians regens, biskop av Bertinoro Martinus Gram, an acolyte from the diocese of Turku and the son of a priest and an unmarried woman, is granted a simple dispensation from illegitimacy by the regent Julianus, bishop of Bertinoro.
DF_source: Arkistolähteet: Vatikaani, Archivum Secretum Vaticanum, Archivio della Penitenzieria Apostolica, Reg. Matrim. et Divers.; Lähde-editiot: APS, #302.Auctoritate Papae. brevtekst:
(Penitentiarians) regens Julianus, biskop i Bertinoro, beviljar Martin Gram, akolyt från Åbo stift och son till en präst och en ogift kvinna, dispens från illegitimitet så att han kan vigas till högre grader och erhålla en kyrklig tjänst med själavård.

Fiat de speciali. Iulianus episcopus Brettonoriensis regens.

sammendrag: Julianus, penitentiarians regens, biskop av Bertinoro Olavus Petri, a priest from the diocese of Turku (or Oslo), once injured a priest. Thus he incurred excommunication but still officiated. Since the priest fully recovered from the injury, Olavus requests absolution and dispensation from irregularity. The regent Julianus, bishop of Bertinoro, grants the petition and refers the case to the diocesan bishop.
DF_source: Arkistolähteet: Vatikaani, Archivum Secretum Vaticanum, Archivio della Penitenzieria Apostolica, Reg. Matrim. et Divers.; Lähde-editiot: APS, #309.Auctoritate Papae. The Church Province of Uppsala and the Apostolic Penitentiary 1410–1526. Sara Risberg (edition), Kirsi Salonen (introduction). Stockholm: National Archives of Sweden 2008.
brevtekst:
(Penitentiarians) regens Julianus, biskop i Bertinoro, beviljar Olof Petersson, präst i Åbo (eller Oslo) stift absolution och dispens från irregularitet för att han skadat en präst, blivit exkommunicerad men ändå tjänstgjort. Ärendet hänvisas till stiftsbiskopen.
Olavus Petri presbyter Aloensis diocesis exponit, quod alias instigante diabolo quendam presbyterum percussit et vulneravit, propter quod excommunicationis sententiam in tales generaliter promulgatam incurrit; et sic ligatus tamquam simplex et iurisignarus non tamen in contemptum clavium divina celebravit officia et <se> eisdem immiscuit. Cum autem dictus presbyter a percussione et vulnere huiusmodi plene convaluerit, supplicatur etc., quatenus ipsum a dicta sententia et excessibus huiusmodi absolvi secumque super irregularitate dicto modo contracta quodque in suis sic susceptis / ordinibus ministrare possit et valeat dispensari mandare misericorditer dignemini de gratia speciali. Fiat de speciali. Iulianus episcopus Brethonoriensis regens. Committatur ordinario.

sammendrag: Julianus, penitentiarians regens, biskop av Bertinoro Martinus of Finland, a priest in the diocese of Trondheim, violently attacked a monastic priest, although no blood was shed, for which reason he incurred excommunication, during which he officiated. The priest fully recovered and was not disqualified from service. The regent Julianus, bishop of Bertinoro, grants Martinus absolution and dispensation.
DF_source: Arkistolähteet: Vatikaani, Archivum Secretum Vaticanum, Archivio della Penitenzieria Apostolica, Reg. Matrim. et Divers.; Lähde-editiot: APS, #315.Auctoritate Papae. The Church Province of Uppsala and the Apostolic Penitentiary 1410–1526. Sara Risberg (edition), Kirsi Salonen (introduction). Stockholm: National Archives of Sweden 2008.
brevtekst:
(Penitentiarians) regens Julianus, biskop i Bertinoro, beviljar Martin från Finland, präst i Nidaros / Trondheim absolution och dispens. Martin angrep med våld en präst och munk, dock utan att blodvite uppstod, varför han blev exkommunicerad. Trots detta tjänstgjorde han och deltog i gudstjänster. Prästbrodern blev helt återställd och kunde fortsätta tjänstgöra.
Martinus de Finlandia presbyter Nidrosiensis diocesis exponit, quod ipse olim manus violentas in quendam presbyterum religiosum citra sanguinis effusionem temere iniecit, propter quod excommunicationis incurrit sententiam in tales generaliter promulgatam; et sic ligatus tamquam simplex et iurisignarus et non in contemptum clavium divina celebravit officia et alias inmiscuit se eisdem. Cum autem, pater sancte, idem presbyter non sit inde effectus inhabilis ad divina, supplicatur igitur eidem sanctitati vestre pro eiusdem exponentis parte, quatenus eum ab excommunicationis sententia et excessibus huiusmodi absolvi ac cum eo super irregularitate ex premissis contracta misericorditer dispensari mandare dignemini de gratia speciali. Fiat de speciali. Iulianus episcopus Bricthonoriensis regens.

I marg.: Rome apud Sanctum Petrum; Rome iii Nonas Februarii; Nidrosiensis diocesis

sammendrag: Julianus, penitentiarians regens, biskop av Bertinoro Bartholomeus “Onde”, a priest from the diocese of Turku, once hit and injured a priest, incurred excommunication but still officiated. The injured priest fully recovered. The regent Julianus, bishop of Bertinoro, absolves Bartholomeus and grants him dispensation from irregularity
DF_source: Arkistolähteet: Vatikaani, Archivum Secretum Vaticanum, Archivio della Penitenzieria Apostolica, Reg. Matrim. et Divers.; Lähde-editiot: APS, #319.Auctoritate Papae. (Penitentiarians) regens Julianus, biskop i Bertinoro, beviljar Bartholomeus "Onde", präst i Åbo stift, absolution och dispens från irregularitet som han ådragit sig genom att slå och skada en präst och sedan fortsätta tjänstgöra under sin exkommunicering. Prästen blev helt återställd.
Bartholomeus Onde presbyter Aboensis diocesis exponit, quod ipse olim quendam presbyterum percussit et vulneravit, propter quod excommunicationis incurrit sententiam in tales generaliter promulgatam; et sic ligatus tamquam simplex et iurisignarus non tamen in contemptum clavium divina celebravit officia et alias immiscuit se eisdem. Cum autem dictus presbyter de percussione huiusmodi plene convaluerit nec factus sit inhabilis <ad> divina, supplicat sanctitati vestre, quatenus eum a dicta sententia et excessibus huiusmodi ac peccatis suis aliis absolvere et cum eo super irregularitate dicto modo contracta dispensare dignemini de gratia speciali. sammendrag: Julianus, penitentiarians regens, biskop av Bertinoro Martinus, the parish priest of Saltvik, and Sigfridus “Neugugni” and Clemens “Nuswuda”, both priests from the diocese of Turku, once assaulted a person without any bloodshed or major violation. They thus incurred excommunication but still officiated. The regent Julianus, bishop of Bertinoro, absolves them and grants them dispensation from irregularity.
DF_source: Arkistolähteet: Vatikaani, Archivum Secretum Vaticanum, Archivio della Penitenzieria Apostolica, Reg. Matrim. et Divers.; Lähde-editiot: APS, #326.Auctoritate Papae. brevtekst:
(Penitentiarians) regens Julianus, biskop i Bertinoro, beviljar Martin, kyrkoherde i Saltvik, Sigfrid "Neugugni" och Clemens "Nuswuda", präster i Åbo stift, absolution och dispens för att de en gång angrep en person, dock utan att blodvite uppstod, varpå de exkommunicerades men ändå fortsatte tjänstgöra och därmed blev irregulära.
Martinus plebanus ecclesie Saltwich et Sigfridus Neugugni et etiam Clemens Nuswuda presbyteri Aboensis diocesis exponunt, quod ipsi olim manus violentas citra sanguinis effusionem et absque tamen aliis excessibus enormibus <in quendam hominem> iniecerunt, propter quod excommunicationis incurrerunt sententias in tales generaliter promulgatas; et sic ligati tanquam simplices et iurisignari non tamen in contemptum clavium divina celebrarunt officia et alias immiscuerunt se divinis. Quare supplicatur humiliter eidem sanctitati vestre pro parte dictorum presbyterorum tam coniunctim quam divisim, quatenus ipsos a dicta sententia excommunicationis et excessibus huiusmodi ac peccatis eorum absolvi ac cum ipsis super irregularitate dicto modo contracta misericorditer dispensare mandare dignemini de gratia speciali. Fiat de speciali. Iulianus episcopus Brethonoriensis regens.

sammendrag: Julianus, penitentiarians regens, biskop av Bertinoro Henningus Johannis, a priest from the diocese of Turku, once chaplain in the church of Lappee (Lappvesi), explains that he and the parish priest’s servant once had an argument. This servant had armed himself one night and followed Henningus and waited for him. When he could not get hold of Henningus, he found one of his servants the following day and hit him instead. When Henningus asked him why he had done this, the servant answered him in insulting words and grasped a mace with the intention of hitting Henningus. Some bystanders, however, stopped him, and he dropped the mace but took hold of his crossbow. Again, the bystanders stopped him from attacking Henningus and took the crossbow away from him. Other weapons were shown on all sides. Then Henningus fled to a house, but he could not open the doors. He then ran towards his carriage, where he found an axe that he could defend himself with. But his enemy came running and took an axe from another carriage, ran towards the Henningus with the intention of hurting and killing him. He then raised the axe and tried to hit him. Fearing his own death, and with no other way to escape, Henningus met the blow from his attacker with an axe-blow on his head. A few days later, this servant died. The regent Julianus, bishop of Bertinoro, refers the case to (the auditor) Franciscus Brevius for inspection, and commissions the diocesan bishop to declare Henningus innocent and not irregular or disqualified, on condition that it can be established that he acted in self-defence.
DF_source: Arkistolähteet: Vatikaani, Archivum Secretum Vaticanum, Archivio della Penitenzieria Apostolica, Reg. Matrim. et Divers.; Lähde-editiot: APS, #332.Auctoritate Papae. The Church Province of Uppsala and the Apostolic Penitentiary 1410–1526. Sara Risberg (edition), Kirsi Salonen (introduction). Stockholm: National Archives of Sweden 2008.
brevtekst:
(Penitentiarians) regens Julianus, biskop i Bertinoro, hänvisar en supplik till (sakhöraren) Franciscus Brevius för kontroll och ger i uppdrag åt biskopen i Åbo att förklara Henning Johansson, präst i Åbo stift, oskyldig till mord, inte irregulär utan tillåten att tjänstgöra, på villkor att följande uppgifter stämmer: Henning var kaplan i Lappee / Lappvesi när han hamnade i bråk med kyrkoherdens tjänare, som hade beväpnat sig, förföljt Henning och väntat på honom. Då han inte fick tag i Henning letade han dagen därpå upp en av hans unga tjänare och slog honom i stället. När Henning frågade varför svarade kyrkoherdens tjänare i förolämpande ordalag och tog en spikklubba för att slå Henning. Han blev stoppad av några som stod i närheten, släppte spikklubban men grep sitt armborst. Åter blev han stoppad och fråntagen armborstet. Både här och där visades vapen fram, och Henning flydde mot ett hus men kunde inte öppna dörren. Då sprang han mot sin vagn och hittade där en yxa att försvara sig med. Kyrkoherdens tjänare kom springande, tog en yxa från en annan vagn och sprang mot Henning för att skada och döda honom. I självförsvar gav Henning sin angripare ett slag med yxan i huvudet. Kyrkoherdens tjänare dog några dagar senare.
Heningius Iohannis quondam cappellanus in ecclesia Lappewesi presbyter Aboensis diocesis exponit, quod, cum olim quedam inter ipsum exponentem et quendam familiarem plebani dicti loci rixe et contentiones orte fuissent, dictus familiaris exponentem deinde odio prosequens malitioso quadam nocte eundem exponentem armatus expectasset eumque minime apprehendisset, quendam exponentis familiarem iuvenem die sequenti comperuit, quem verberavit. Quod dum exponens prefatus sensisset, prefatum verberatorem, quare talia machinaretur, inquisisset. Qui verbis mox iniuriosis oratori exhibens arreptaque quadam fuste costis ferreis clavis circumsepta, quo exponentem percutere nitebatur, per astantes tamen illic impeditus fustem prefatam dimisit et quandam balistam sive arcum ipsius arripuit, quibus exponentem offendisset, nisi iterum per astantes impeditus fuisset, qui balistam prefatam e manibus vi receperunt. Qua deinde recepta alia hincinde arma invasoria perlustrabantur. Interea vero exponens versus quandam domum fugam vertisset, cuius portas aperire non potuit. Ad quoddam vehiculum suum in domo plebani prefati paulo ante transvectum cucurrit, super quo quandam securim, qua se defenderet, reperiret. Et cum sic inter duo vehicula gratia querendi securim constitutus esset, dictus adversarius alterum vehiculum celeriter accurrens, ex quo securim extraxit et in oratorem irruit eumque animo offendere et occidere proposuisset securimque erexit et exponentem percutere nitebatur. Exponens vero videns se absque enormi lesione evadere non posse mortisque periculum imminere ictum dicti invasoris reparavit eumque exinde securi in capite percussit et vulneravit. Ex quibus deinde paucis diebus effluxis, sicut Domino placuit, expiravit. Cum autem, pater sancte, dictus exponens in morte dicti invasoris aliter, quam ut premittitur, culpabilis non fuerit nec aliter mortem evadere sperabat de eiusque morte ab intimis doluerit, prout dolet de presenti, cupiatque in suis ordinibus perpetuo Domino famulari, a nonnullis tamen simplicibus et iurisignaris ac ipsius exponentis forsan emulis asseritur ipsum propter premissa homicidii reatum incurrisse et propterea in ordinibus prefatis ministrare non posse. Ad ora igitur talium et aliarum sibi super hoc forsan in futurum obloqui volentium emulorum obstruenda supplicatur sanctitati vestre pro parte dicti exponentis, quatenus ipsum propter premissa nullum homicidii reatum incurrisse nullamque irregularitatis maculam sive inhabilitatis notam contraxisse sed premissis non obstantibus in suis susceptis ordinibus ministrare ac quecumque beneficia ecclesiastica per eum forsan obtenta et in futurum forsan canonice conferenda recipere et retinere libere et licite posse declarari mandare dignemini in forma. Fiat ut infra. Iulianus episcopus Brethonoriensis regens. Videat eam dominus Franciscus Brevius. Iulianus. Comittatur ordinario, ut, si vocatis vocandis sibi constiterit de assertis, et quod supplicans ad sui necessariam deffensionem et cum moderamine inculpate tutele percusserit, declaret, ut petitur.

sammendrag: Julianus, penitentiarians regens, biskop av Bertinoro The provost Laurentius Suurpää, the archdeacon Sigfridus, the dean Magnus Johannis, the archpriest Magnus Laurentii, the canon Johannes Jacobi, and also another canon of the cathedral of Turku are said to have incurred excommunication for not having obeyed a letter of warning issued by the Camera Apostolica at the request of the bishop of Strängnäs. While excommunicated, they officiated, for which reason they are said to have incurred irregularity. The exponents consider themselves innocent. The regent Julianus, bishop of Bertinoro, grants them absolution.
DF_source: Arkistolähteet: Vatikaani, Archivum Secretum Vaticanum, Archivio della Penitenzieria Apostolica, Reg. Matrim. et Divers.; Lähde-editiot: APS, #343.Auctoritate Papae. The Church Province of Uppsala and the Apostolic Penitentiary 1410–1526. Sara Risberg (edition), Kirsi Salonen (introduction). Stockholm: National Archives of Sweden 2008.
brevtekst:
(Penitentiarians) regens Julianus, biskop i Bertinoro, beviljar prosten Lars Suurpää, ärkedjäknen Sigfrid, dekanen Magnus Johansson, ärkeprästen Magnus Larsson (Grisfot), kaniken Johan Jakobsson (=Jakob Johansson?) och ytterligare en kanik i Åbo domkyrka absolution. Supplikanterna anses ha blivit exkommunicerade för att de inte åtlytt ett varningsbrev utfärdat av Apostoliska kammaren på uppdrag av biskopen i Strängnäs. Under denna exkommunicering har de tjänstgjort, varför de påstås ha ådragit sig irregularitet. Supplikanterna anser sig vara oskyldiga.
Laurentius Swripe prepositus, Sifredus archidiaconus, Magnus Iohannis decanus, Magnus Laurentii archipresbyteri ac Iohannes Iacobi canonicus ac unus alter ex canonicis ecclesie Aboensis eorundem complex exponunt, quod [cum] ab aliquibus asseratur eos in quandam excommunicationis sententiam ob non paritionem certi monitorii penalis a curia causarum camere apostolice ad instantiam episcopi Strengenensis emanati incidisse et eos sic ligatos non tamen in contemptum clavium divina celebrando officia et alias immiscendo se eisdem irregularitatem contraxisse. Cum autem, pater sancte, [licet] dicti exponentes in premissis sese culpabiles existere non credant, quia tamen bonarum mentium est timere, ubi culpa non est, supplicatur humiliter sanctitati vestre pro parte dictorum exponentium, quatenus ipsos a dicta sententia, si quam meruerunt, si non absoluti fuerint, ab excessibus huiusmodi, a peccatis suis absolvi ac cum eis et eorum quolibet super irregularitate, si quam premissorum occasione contraxerunt, absolvi mandare dignemini de gratia speciali. Fiat de speciali, postquam a speciali sententia rite fuerunt absoluti. Iulianus episcopus Britonoriensis regens.

sammendrag: Julianus, penitentiarians regens, biskop av Bertinoro Canutus “Molle”, a priest from the diocese of Turku, committed a theft when he was young and was therefore removed from office by the diocesan bishop. Nevertheless, Canutus officiated, believing he was permitted to do so through a licence given to him by the archbishop of Lund. And although he has been reinstated to office through an apostolic letter issued by the penitentiary, Canutus doubts that this letter will support his case, since there is no mention of his celebration of the Divine Office or the irregularity he had incurred. In order to purge himself of these acts, he has made pilgrimages to the Holy Sepulchre, Saint Jacob of Compostella and the Cave of Saint Mary Magdalene (in Provence) before coming to Rome, where he is now. The regent Julianus, bishop of Bertinoro, absolves Canutus and gives him dispensation from irregularity
DF_source: Arkistolähteet: Vatikaani, Archivum Secretum Vaticanum, Archivio della Penitenzieria Apostolica, Reg. Matrim. et Divers.; Lähde-editiot: APS, #346.Auctoritate Papae. The Church Province of Uppsala and the Apostolic Penitentiary 1410–1526. Sara Risberg (edition), Kirsi Salonen (introduction). Stockholm: National Archives of Sweden 2008.
brevtekst:
(Penitentiarians) regens Julianus, biskop i Bertinoro, beviljar Knut "Molle", präst i Åbo stift, absolution och dispens från den irregularitet han ådrog sig när han som ung gjorde sig skyldig till stöld och fråntogs sin tjänst av stiftsbiskopen. Knut fortsatte dock tjänstgöra i tron att han fått tillstånd till det av ärkebiskopen i Lund. Trots att han nu återinsatts i tjänst genom ett apostoliskt brev utfärdat av penitentiarian, tvivlar Knut på att det hjälper honom eftersom där inte nämns något om gudstjänstfirande och irregularitet. För att rättfärdiga sig har Knut gjort pilgrimsfärder till den heliga graven, Santiago de Compostela och Maria Magdalenas grotta (i Provence) innan han kommit till Rom, där han nu är.
Canutus Molle presbyter Aboensis diocesis exponit, quod ipse alias in iuvenili etate constitutus quoddam furtum commisit, propter quod ab officio sacerdotali per loci ordinarium iudicialiter depositus fuit. Qui postmodum predicta depositione non obstante missas et alia divina celebravit officia ac alias immiscuit se eisdem credens id licite facere posse pretextu certarum licentiarum sibi per archiepiscopum Lundensem concessarum. Et licet ad officium sacerdotale predictum fuerit per quasdam litteras apostolicas ab officio penitentiarie sanctitatis vestre emanatas restitutus, quia tamen de divinorum celebratione huiusmodiet irregularitate propter ea contracta nullam fecit in litteris ipsis mentionem et de novo non tamen in contemptum clavium sed per simplicitatem et iurisignorantiam divinis se immiscuit eisdem, dubitat litteras predictas sibi minime suffragari. Cum autem, pater sancte, idem orator de excessibus huiusmodi plurimum doluerit et doleat ab intimis et pro illorum expurgatione diversa loca sancta et pia ac dominicum sepulchrum ac limina sancti Iacobi in Compostella necnon speluncam sancte Marie Magdalene peregrinando non sine magnis laboribus visitaverit ac tandem ad curiam Romanam venit, in qua est de presenti, supplicatur igitur sanctitati vestre pro eiusdem exponentis parte humiliter, quatinus ipsum a sententiis, censuris et penis ecclesiasticis, si quas forsan propterea incurrerit, ac excessibus huiusmodi / ac peccatis suis aliis etc. absolvere secumque super irregularitate predicta, quodque in omnibus per eum susceptis ordinibus – etiam in altaris ministerio – libere et licite possit et valeat, dispensare omnemque irregularitatis et inhabilitatis et infamie maculam sive notam per eum premissorum occasione contractas sive insurgentes circa eum penitus abolere misericorditer dignemini de gratia speciali et expresso. Fiat de speciali et expresso. Iulianus episcopus Brictonoriensis regens.
